description: CAL-2 proxy: free-neutron β-decay Q-value Q_β(n), derived from the CODATA-2022 registry as (m_n − m_p) − m_e. Per the QOU three-calibration discipline (folio/quantum-observable-universe/braids-and-knots/three-calibration-inputs.md), Q_β(n) is the numerical proxy for CAL-2, the neutron β-decay width 𝔇_β with Q_β = ℏ/𝔇_β — NOT CAL-3, which is the pion decay width 𝔇_π with proxy m_π (owner ruling 2026-06-26; the witness stem 'cal-3-q-beta' is historical and is kept only to avoid a rename blast radius). It fixes the hadronic energy scale E_0 via E_0 = Q_β(n) / |Δ(net)|, where Δ(net) = h(h-2)/2 is the symbolic NF difference between neutron and proton braids. This witness exists so codata_constants.py loads the value from a source-of-truth JSON instead of hardcoding it. DATASET (owner ruling 2026-11-20, "CODATA 2022"; bean qou-0e2p / PR #7205): sourced from the CODATA-2022 registry rather than the AME-2020 direct value 0.78233341(61), so that CAL-1, CAL-2 and CAL-3 come from one experimental dataset. The two determinations differ by +190.85 ppb = +0.208 σ — statistically indistinguishable, so this is a dataset-consistency choice and NOT an accuracy claim; the residual direction is an outcome, never a reason.

parameters.source: CODATA 2022 registry: neutron-proton mass difference energy equivalent (1.29333251(38) MeV) minus m_e.
parameters.calibration_id_note: Q_β is the CAL-2 proxy (CAL-2 = 𝔇_β, the neutron β-decay width, Q_β = ℏ/𝔇_β). CAL-3 is 𝔇_π with proxy m_π. This witness read 'CAL-3' until 2026-11-20 on main (PR #7205 first corrected it on 2026-09-12 but never merged); the stem is historical, the label was simply wrong against AGENTS.md's canonical table.
parameters.role: Hadronic energy scale E_0 via E_0 = Q_β(n) / |Δ(net)|
parameters.data_source: CODATA-2022 neutron-proton mass difference energy equivalent 1.29333251(38) MeV, minus m_e = 0.51099895069 MeV. Sourced from codata_2022_source.M_N_MINUS_P_MEV − M_E_MEV, and cross-checked against M_N_MEV_CODATA_DIRECT − M_P_MEV − M_E_MEV (agree to ~1e-49 at 50 dps). Was codata_2022_source.Q_BETA_MEV_AME (AME-2020 direct, 0.78233341(61)) until 2026-11-20.

data.consistency_check_is_now_circular: codata_constants checks Q_beta against m_n - m_p - m_e. Under AME-2020 that residual was 1.4931e-7 MeV (190.85 ppb, 0.22 sigma) -- a genuine cross-dataset comparison. Under this CODATA-2022 route the two sides are the same quantity, so it is ~1e-49, i.e. ZERO BY CONSTRUCTION. Do not read that as improved accuracy; the check has lost its (already slight) independence and should be re-pointed at Q_beta_n_MeV_ame2020 or retired.
downstream_consumers: neutron-gap-probes-round3.witness.json 3-input mass split: m_n_pred = m_p_pred + Q_β + m_e
